Regulations 30 and 46 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) 
 
Ref: (a) Advance intimation of quarterly earnings conference call dated 2nd October 2026 
 
 (b) Outcome of Board Meeting dated 15th October 2026 
 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
In terms of Regulations 30 and 46 read with clause 15 of para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI 
Listing Regulations, we hereby inform you that the Company has today viz. Thursday, 15th October  
2026, concluded its quarterly earnings conference call with several Analysts/Institutional 
Investors/Funds on the Audited Financial Results of the Company for the second quarter and half year 
ended 30th September 2026. 
 
The Investor Presentation, which was sent to the Stock Exchanges vide our letter dated 15th October 
2026

quarterly earnings conference call.  
 
The earnings conference call commenced at 6.00 p.m. (IST) and concluded at 7.05 p.m. (IST).
